## About
Autotronics Service & Body is a specialized automotive workshop on Claremont Street in San Mateo. We maintain and repair a variety of European vehicles, with a focus on Mercedes-Benz and BMW, using up-to-date equipment.
Our mechanics have received factory Mercedes-Benz and BMW training, and the work is directed by Mercedes-Benz Master Technicians and ASE certified Master Technicians. We aim for high quality work and fast turnaround, all without the high prices of dealerships.
Customers have given us a 4.3 rating across 37 Google reviews. One reviewer describes Joyce, the owner, as someone who takes the time to explain the work being done.

## Services
- "A" service: Synthetic oil (MB spec) and filter change, fluid top-off, service reminder reset, inspection of belts, tires, brakes, battery, lights, wipers and horns, plus a complete vehicle safety inspection.
- "B" service: Synthetic oil (MB spec) and filter change, fluid top-off, service reminder reset, A/C pollen filter and engine air filter replacement, tire rotation and balance when applicable, and a complete safety inspection.
- Oil service: Synthetic oil and filter change, fluid top-off, service reminder reset, tire rotation and balance when applicable, and a complete vehicle safety inspection.
- Inspection I: Oil and filter change, fluid top-off, service reminder reset, A/C pollen filter and engine air filter service, tire rotation and balance when applicable, and a complete safety inspection.
- BMW Inspection II: Call us for an accurate description of what is included for your model of BMW.
- Xenon (HID) headlight conversions: Conversions for all makes and models in your choice of color and output.
- Headlight restoration: We bring dull, faded plastic headlight lenses back to clear.
- Mercedes-Benz Star Diagnostics version coding: Version coding using Mercedes-Benz Star Diagnostics.
- Mercedes-Benz power programming: Programming for more power, or for lower octane fuel to save money at the pump.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on Mercedes-Benz and BMW?
A: No. Those are our specialty, but our services are not limited to them. Give us a call with any questions about your car.

Q: Is there anywhere to go while I wait?
A: One reviewer pointed out that Takahashi Market is right down the street, a good spot to grab a snack while your car is being worked on.
